title: Pasiva refleja básica y concordancia de número
goal: Master basic passive reflex constructions with 'se' and ensure strict subject-verb number agreement with postposed plural patients.
grammar: pasiva refleja básica y concordancia estricta de número con el sujeto paciente

items: Formulate passive reflex sentences with 'se' and third-person verbs.
Ensure mandatory plural agreement when the passive subject is plural (se firmaron los acuerdos).
Differentiate passive patients from direct objects.
